name: Bubble
tagline: A visual no-code platform for building web and mobile apps, with AI to generate a first version.
about: Bubble lets you design an app, its database and its logic visually. AI can build a starting point from a description, and you edit it by hand from there.
pros: Full visual control over design, data and logic.
AI can generate a starting app from a description.
cons: Apps stay on Bubble; you cannot export the code.
